interface.attach_documents(raw, loader): Returns same RawItem; attaches separate supporting evidence and diagnostics; primary page_text/event_date untouched. Existing loader enforces robots and saves responses.
interface.verified_document_text(raw, hosts): Returns re-extracted verified text only; corrupted claimed evidence raises DeferredProcessing. Required IST report without its document raises required_supporting_document_pending; optional missing ACHS documents return empty text.

integrity_requirements: Exact configured binding plus href inside scoped parent article, excluding nav/footer/related posts
Revalidate primary capture and publisher date evidence against saved source bytes
Saved response JSON and exact saved binary SHA256 match attached evidence
Every response hop uses an official public HTTPS authority and verified TLS; final HTTP200; no WAF or incomplete curl response
Compatible media type and binary signature; never interpret HTML access challenge as PDF
Re-extract document text and compare SHA256/text/page/truncation fields before returning facts
No PDF metadata, HTTP dates, upload-path dates or data-period years become publication dates

limits.partial_marker: truncated=true when pages or chars exceed limits; no complete-document claim

publication_contract: Primary dated article remains publication authority; ReportIST2025 publication2026-07-14 and period2025 are independent. Document publication date remains None.
pending_next_step: Root requests the four exact public binaries in Actions; attach only when saved responses pass proof, inspect actual additional facts, then consider changed editorial input without lowering75.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_occupational_documents.py tests/test_occupational_evidence.py tests/test_achs_document_routes.py tests/test_occupational_integrity.py
tests.result: 129 passed; includes four live parent HTML href/hash bindings and synthetic integrity/binary regressions
